causality.reason: The list returns registered SwiftVirtualNetwork items while its associated resource is SiteSiloVirtualNetworkConnection. The old matcher cannot traverse the non-templated named collection model; the PR reads its actual value[] item.
causality.old_response_evidence: ArmResponse<SiteSiloVirtualNetworkConnectionCollection> exposes the named collection as its argument. The old checker neither follows sourceModel nor value[], so it cannot reach the different registered SwiftVirtualNetwork.
causality.new_response_evidence: The new HTTP list-body traversal reads inherited/copied value[] and obtains SwiftVirtualNetwork. SwiftVirtualNetwork.tsp:19 and SiteSilo.tsp:103 are distinct ProxyResource declarations, with no discriminated ancestry exception.
causality.contract_disposition: The silo list intentionally reuses the established SwiftVirtualNetwork wire resource; canonical association is the silo-specific resource. A real newly exposed named-wrapper/item mismatch, not automatically a native false positive or an old warning.
